title: plan-register/1
description: Delivery-unit register (plan-register/1). This schema is an editor aid only (its $id is an identifier, not a download location; projects use the copy that vendor writes); the plan-register CLI ("plan-register check") is the authority and also checks cross-references, files and anchors.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this JSON Schema, for hints only (ignored by the CLI): normally the path, relative to the register file, of the project copy that vendor writes (scripts/plan-register-1.schema.json).

$comment.description: Free-form comment for humans; ignored by the CLI.

config.description: Project settings: unit naming, key patterns, plan directories, generated regions, TODOs, decision logs, archive.

units.description: Delivery units and gates, in register order.

unitName.description: Singular name of a unit in generated text, for example "wave" or "package".

unitNamePlural.description: Plural name of a unit for table headings, for example "batches". Defaults to unitName + "s".

keyPatterns.description: Regular expressions that unit keys must match, per kind. "delivery" is required; "gate" is needed only when gates exist.

planDirs.description: Directories that hold plan documents. Non-scope plans must live in one of them; an active plan whose **Source:** line names a unit key must be registered for it.

regions.description: Generated regions in Markdown files, each between <!-- marker --> comments.

todos.description: Where TODO files live and which open TODOs are deliberately left without a home unit.

decisionLogs.description: Decision logs that unit "decisions" refer to.

skipReasonMin.description: Minimum length of the reason after a skipped checkbox. Default 15.

archive.description: Archive directory for closed plans and the banner/closedBy templates.

guidelinesFile.description: Project rules file that receives the "Planning conventions" section. Default <planDirs[0].path>/PLAN_GUIDELINES.md.

keyPatterns.description: Key regular expressions per unit kind.

delivery.description: Regular expression for keys of delivery units, for example "^ST-(0|[1-9]\\d*)$".

gate.description: Regular expression for keys of gate units.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the directory.

region.description: A generated region in a Markdown file.

file.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the Markdown file.

marker.description: Region marker name; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

views.description: Views rendered into the region, in order.

todos.description: TODO file locations. An open TODO is a .md file directly in "dir", except names in "exclude".

archiveDir.description: Directory (searched at any depth) of closed TODO files.

exclude.description: File names in "dir" that are not TODOs. Default ["README.md"].

unhomed.description: Open TODOs deliberately without a home unit: TODO path -> non-empty reason.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the decision log.

idPattern.description: Regular expression for decision IDs in this log, for example "^RD-\\d+$".

dir.description: Archive directory; it must also be covered by config.planDirs so archived plans stay registered.

banner.description: Banner template for archived plans. Placeholders: {outcome}, {closedBy}, {pr}, {sha}. Default "ARCHIVED / {outcome} — {closedBy}".

closedBy.description: Template for a unit's closedBy text. Placeholders: {pr}, {sha}. Default "PR #{pr}, {sha}".

key.description: Phase key; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, for example "core".

aliases.description: Other names of the phase; they share one namespace with phase keys.

roadmap.description: Roadmap link as path#anchor; the file and the anchor must exist.

unit.description: A delivery unit or a gate.

key.description: Unit key; must match config.keyPatterns for the unit kind.

kind.description: Unit kind. Default "delivery"; a "gate" is a step without a PR.

aliases.description: Other names of the unit; they share one namespace with unit keys.

phase.description: Key of the phase this unit belongs to.

pr.description: Number of the open PR; only while "In progress", never on a gate.

owner.description: Who owns the unit (typically a gate).

dependsOn.description: Keys of units that must be closed before this one is ready.

after.description: Keys of units that come earlier in the order only; they do not block readiness.

waitsOn.description: External blockers: a decision, a credential or an external dependency.

plans.description: Plan documents registered for this unit.

todos.description: Paths of TODO files homed in this unit.

decisions.description: Decision IDs from config.decisionLogs that this unit relies on.

closedBy.description: How the unit was closed, for example "PR #12, abc1234"; required for Done, only allowed for Done or Superseded.

plan.description: A plan document (or a section of one) registered for a unit.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the .md plan.

section.description: Heading text that identifies this unit's section when one file holds several units.

role.description: Role of the plan for the unit.

scope.description: Free-form note on which part of the plan applies.

waitsOn.description: An external blocker of a unit.

ref.description: What the unit waits on: a decision ID, a credential name or an external reference.
